repos.name: nearpay-brain
repos.purpose: Architecture, decisions, LLDs, development plan

repos.name: nearpay-spec
repos.purpose: Single source of truth for every contract, authored as zod schemas in TypeScript and emitted as OpenAPI 3.1 / AsyncAPI / JSON Schema: public REST, internal service APIs, domain events, webhook payloads, error catalogue, NearPay x402 scheme, shared test vectors

repos.name: nearpay-kit
repos.purpose: Small, versioned TypeScript runtime libraries shared by services: integer money, IDs, service bootstrap (Fastify + OpenTelemetry), Postgres helpers (outbox, inbox, idempotency), NATS JetStream bus, internal auth, resilient HTTP, NEAR Intents payload build/sign/verify, chain address validation, test utilities

repos.name: nearpay-identity
repos.purpose: Accounts, users, roles, passkey sessions, API keys, settlement destinations with attestation (active immediately; optional operator cool-off), gateway authorisation

repos.name: nearpay-payments
repos.purpose: Payment lifecycle: checkout sessions, payment intents, attempts, refunds, payment links, customers, statement ledger, reconciliation

repos.name: nearpay-billing
repos.purpose: Products, prices, manual tax rates, invoices, subscriptions, dunning, and the vault keeper for auto-debit mandates

repos.name: nearpay-rails
repos.purpose: Value movement: route providers (1Click live, sandbox in test mode), token registry, pricing/FX, executions, tracking (hot poller, Explorer feed, NEAR indexer, destination watchers with amount tags), Tier-A chain verifiers

repos.name: nearpay-agentpay
repos.purpose: x402 v2 facilitator (exact: intents-transfer, near-intents) and a batching relayer for signed NEAR Intents with a function-call key pool

repos.name: nearpay-compliance
repos.purpose: Address screening, KYB cases, geo policy, compliance cases and blocklists; policies are data per jurisdiction

repos.name: nearpay-webhooks
repos.purpose: Public event log, webhook endpoints, signed delivery with retries, replay and delivery logs

repos.name: nearpay-notify
repos.purpose: Transactional email (sign-in links, receipts, invoices, reminders, security alerts) through one SMTP provider

repos.name: nearpay-sandbox
repos.purpose: Deterministic simulator of the route provider and chains for test mode, local development and E2E (NEAR Intents has no testnet)

repos.name: nearpay-sentinel
repos.purpose: Independent second party with its own code, credentials and deploy pipeline: co-signs every deposit instruction shown by checkout after re-reading the quote from 1Click and matching it to an active destination in identity's registry; independently re-reconciles succeeded payments against chain evidence; owns the global quoting kill switch

repos.name: nearpay-checkout
repos.purpose: Hosted checkout, payment links, hosted invoices and the embedded iframe app; wallet adapters; deposit instructions; live status

repos.name: nearpay-js
repos.purpose: Widget loader and client SDKs that mount the checkout iframe and speak a versioned postMessage protocol

repos.name: nearpay-dashboard
repos.purpose: Merchant dashboard: payments, refunds (with wallet signing), invoices, subscriptions, customers, developers (keys, webhooks, events, logs), settlement, team

repos.name: nearpay-console
repos.purpose: Internal operations: merchants, business details, compliance cases, screening hits, execution explorer, verification holds, kill switch, reconciliation, audit log

repos.name: nearpay-site
repos.purpose: Public static sites from one Astro project: developer documentation at `docs.` (guides, API reference generated from nearpay-spec, webhooks, test mode, agents, error pages) and the marketing site at the apex domain (product, pricing, legal pages)

repos.name: nearpay-node
repos.purpose: Server SDK for Node/TypeScript: typed resources, automatic idempotency keys and retries, webhook signature verification, refund signing helpers

repos.name: nearpay-agentkit
repos.purpose: Agent payments toolkit: x402 server middleware (Express/Hono/Next) and client, MCP server for agents, NEAR Intents signing helpers

repos.name: nearpay-cli
repos.purpose: Developer CLI: login, listen (forward webhooks to localhost), trigger test events, tail logs, resend events

repos.name: nearpay-contracts
repos.purpose: NEAR smart contracts: the subscription vault for auto-debit (built and tested; not deployed on mainnet)

repos.name: nearpay-infra
repos.purpose: Planned host provisioning and cluster bootstrap as code (Ansible, Terraform, k3s, Argo CD); a scaffold with no code yet

repos.name: nearpay-deploy
repos.purpose: How NearPay runs: the Docker Compose stack, scripts for the local stack and the live beta, monitoring, and the local package registry

repos.name: nearpay-testbed
repos.purpose: Whole-system verification and demos: merchant-demo app, demo scripts (checkout, agent), ops CLI wrapper, cross-service end-to-end suites
